notes.title: Lunar Union Event - Rewards Delivery
notes.content:
Hello, Castaways!

We’ve discovered a bug that prevents players from retrieving items after completing the Lunar Union Festival missions. We know how frustrating this can be, especially after all the effort you’ve put into the event, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. 

To solve this issue, we’ll be [b]delivering the missing items through the Frog Box[/b]—a special mailbox in the game that distributes rewards and other goodies to all players. If you don’t already have a Frog Box, simply speak to Frogboy and he’ll give you one.

You’ll have from [i]February 12th until March 11th[/i] to retrieve your rewards from the Frog Box. After that date, the mail will expire, so please make sure to collect your items before then. We wouldn’t want you to miss out!

If you encounter any issues or have questions, feel free to reach out to us here or on Discord.

Thank you so much for your patience and for being part of our community. Your support means the world to us, and we’re committed to making Ikonei Island the best it can be for all Castaways.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]🛠️ Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]🖌️Art [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted colors for better enemy progressions
[*] New enemy type: Vipeagon
[*] Added tutorial images for new onboarding
[*] Easter outfit
[*] Easter placeable assets
[*] Easter plant
[*] Minor VFX tweaks
[*] Minor shader fixes
[*] Visual bug fixes
[*] Optimisation on ground shader
[/list]
[h3][b]💻 Code[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Features:
[list]
[*] New region rating system
[*] Tutorial popups
[*] The guiding orb
[*] Perspective toggle
[*] Puzzle system
[*] Mailbox system
[*] New cutscene system
[*] Pause mechanic
[*] Sprinklers
[/list]
[*] Tweaks:
[list][*] Combat
[list][*] Monsters now have slightly varying health.
[*] Player characters will now in some cases be left with half a heart from attacks that would otherwise defeat them.
[*] The forward momentum of attacks is now scaled with the velocity of the player character.
[*] Monsters can now damage each other. Sometimes there might break out between monsters.
[*] Monsters can now alert each other of nearby player characters.
[*] Placement mode
[*] Player characters can now move while in placement mode. 
[*] Direction that the placement mode spline pans is now based on whether the player character is picking up an item or dropping an item. [/list]
[*] Shops
[list][*] Shops now restock right away when a shop state is updated. The player no longer needs to go to sleep to get the latest added stock. [/list]
[*] Workorders
[list][*] Workorders now have a visual light beam to indicate that it is active.
[*] Daler can now be awarded for completing workorders. [/list]
[*] General player character
[list][*] Player characters are now invulnerable during cutscenes.[/list]
[*] Companions
[list][*] Companions can now be summoned via a summon interaction on a sleeping companion.
[*] Companions now walk up to the player character when they are ready to evolve. 
[*] Evolving a creature is now done via an interaction. [/list]
[*] UI
[list][*] Changing the zoom level of the map can now be done with the scroll wheel.[/list]
[*] Island Ratings
[list][*] The rating for decorating your island now uses a flexible evaluation that takes multiple factors into account to determine a final score
[*] New activity types have been added - Farming, Slaying Monsters, and rebuilding NPC buildings [/list]
[*] Crafting
[list][*] Input items can now be removed from in-progress refining stations[/list]
[*] Gardening
[list][*] Can water sand directly instead of plants
[*] Watering Cans now show a preview for range[/list]
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]🎨 Design[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Construction Altars now have a visual beam when they are active.
[*] The game can now be paused in Single Player.
[*] The night no longer lasts forever. 
[*] Sleeping sets the time for the start of a new Moonrun.
[*] The Daily Summary Screen has been removed.
[*] New Tutorial Screens added. They pop up as you play the game.
[*] The Crafting Station is removed from the game, and recipes that require the Crafting Station have been updated to not require it.
[*] The Hatchet, Hammer, and Pollen Bag have been removed from the game.
[*] Added Mailbox functionality.
[*] Puzzles have been added - they will refresh itself in periods of time.
[*] New enemy - Vipeagon.
[*] Region Rating System Overhaul
[list][*] Each region now has a list of activities that need to be completed to reach 5 stars.
[*] Each new star level gives a reward and increases the amount of resources that can be found in that region. [/list]
[*] Onboarding Changes: 
[list][*] New starting position
[*] Guiding light
[*] Sariel quest moved
[*] New companion as the first companion
[*] Player House is part of the starting quest
[*] New lake
[*] A new farming area near the Heartland Shrine
[*] Milas’ quest moved and changed[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]💬 Narrative: [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Onboarding changes
[*] Added Pebblefluffs Eggcellent Adventure
[*] Dialogue and item names
[/list]
[h3][b]💃 Animation[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated player attack animations
[*] Fixed all NPC teleport animations
[*] Authored individual creature evolve cutscenes
[*] Fixed Bibi sleeping mid-air
[*] Rigged and animated Sprinkler
[*] Rigged and animated DLC chest
[*] Rigged and animated Easter placeables
[*] Replaced coins with letters, for Frogboy Coin Machine
[*] Added missing talk animation to Milas animation set
[/list]
[h3][b]🖥️ GUI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated visuals of all UI elements
[*] Updated companion HUD element to show a companions needs
[*] New HUD element to show activities in each region
[/list]
[h3][b]🎶 Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Project Mix Updated
[*] Snowcastle Logo Splash Screen Audio Mix updated
[*] New UI Sound Effects and Revamp into UI SFX System
[*] New Sound Effects for Vipeagon
[*] New Sound Effects for Easter Update
[*] Pirate Camp faster music-loop breaking-bug fixed
[*] Audio added to all new animations
[*] New SFX for Creature Evolving Cutscene
[*] New SFX system for Guiding Orb
[*] Music now plays on game pause
[*] Fixed Reverb spread bug
[/list]
[h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Various collision fixes.
[*] Missing Blockers should now appear on the map as intended.
[*] Fixed overlapping text in menus.
[*] A rare save/load crash has been fixed.
[*] Achievement fixed for multiplayer.
[/list]
[h3][b]🙇 Known Issues We Are Working On[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Grass is not rendering properly when farming and placing items on the ground.
[*] The items sometimes could disappear from the screen but they will come back within 3-5 seconds.
[*] Currently the game has significant performance issues on Xbox One, we’re working on it. It plays delightfully on Xbox X | S.
[*] Currently the game has some performance issues on PS4, we’re working on it. It plays delightfully on PS5.
[*] If you purchased the DLC but you are a guest on your friend’s island (who has no DLC), you will see an empty chest. We are fixing this issue. In the future, the player will be able to see the chest with your purchased DLC only on your island.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Improved the beginning of the game
[*] The game now starts at a different location.

[*] The Combat Tutorial has been moved to after you reach the Hamlet.
[*] Improved the starting path to better guide the player towards the Hamlet.
[*] Thorn Bushes can no longer be destroyed by swords.
[*] Building the Tree House and the rooms inside it are now cheaper.
[*] The Gardening Chest should be easier to find.
[*] The Tree House can no longer be acquired as a placeable item. A permanent Tree House is located in the area where Sariel teaches you how to create a garden.
[*] Frogboy jumps away right after introducing the S.E.L.L. Chest. Find him in the Froglet Grove to buy the Tent.
[*] Sariel now opens her shop earlier than before.
[*] Some items, like the Frog House, should now be available in Frogboy’s Shop earlier.
[/list]
[h3][b]👀 Visuals[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Scholar Statues has an updated visual to be easier to see. It also starts glowing when you place a Frog on it to unlock that part of the map.
[*] Updated Achievement, Companion Level, and Quest Icons.
[*] New 4K loading screens implemented
[*] New and improved visuals for the Daily Summary Screen.
[/list]
[h3][b]💃 Animation[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Sitting Animations for each object the player can sit on.
[*] Combat
[*] Updated size and color of the monsters of the island to better showcase their power level
[*] Removed the Amri Root connected to Monster Spawners on the island. 
[*] Monsters Spawned by Monster Spawners are stronger than before.
[*] Added more places for monsters to naturally spawn on the island.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Economy Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple items have had their Sell and Buy prices adjusted.
[*] Valuable items have a chance to drop from multiple new sources.
[*] Ribbits can now be found when cutting Tall Grass.
[*] Digging gives more Sand in the Desert Dunes and Dawning Sands, and more Snow in the Sunless Horn. 
[*] Fishing Nodes should now spawn more frequently in Fenland Point.
[*] Ribbits can now be auto-picked up.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]🖥️ GUI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Buy Button is now greyed out when selecting an item in a shop that you can’t afford.
[*] The Health Bar in the inventory screen is now below the player’s name.
[*] The list of players playing is now only visible when more than one player is playing.
[*] Sell Value is now visible on the description text of items that can be sold.
[*] Icons for cycling through the Item Bars should now be more visible.
[*] Added a button on the Title Screen for easy access to our other available games.
[*] Updated animation showing Ribbits gained and lost.
[*] Added notice and solution prompt for fixing corrupted saves.
[/list]
[h3][b]🎶 Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mixing Updates on music and general audio
[/list]

notes.title: Ikonei Island: Friends' Pass Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/9eb38373121899678ee1a4e819d643daaa18d5ca.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Hello there, Castaways! 🏝️[/b][/h1]

Visiting the glorious Ikonei Island is always a delight, whether you are befriending colorful creatures, battling treasure-hungry pirates, or crafting beautiful homesteads. But there is nothing better than doing this with your friends ♥

[b]Today we release the “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/][b]Ikonei Island: Friend’s Pass[/b][/url]” which means that you are now free to hop onto the Island and explore the online multiplayer co-op experience with up to 3 of your friends. Anyone can play alone or together for the first two hours of play![/b]

[h3][b]BUT if at least one of you owns the full version you can play indefinitely![/b][/h3]

Hop into it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/

Gather resources, craft tools, and gear. Farm the land, build your base or a cozy home, and decorate it however you like.

You just need to make a "Ribbit Request" (a Join Code) to be able to join in the same game session together. Oh! And IMPORTANT! Ensure everyone who tries to play the co-op is using the latest updates - otherwise, you may unfortunately risk experiencing crashes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/809581a16f3f9cc54ef18e8dcb060e622573e846.gif[/img]
[i]1. Copy the Join Code under Multiplayer Options and share it with your friends.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/a2b3ce7c5f2725c2b96a8231c1afcfd00b49d51e.gif[/img]
[i]2. Paste that on Join Game and that's it! Embark on the wholesome adventure of Ikonei Island together ♥[/i]

If your demo runs out, do not worry - after you purchase the base game you can continue where you left off.

[h3][b]We are also announcing the full launch date will be…. 🥁🥁🥁🥁🥁 November 9th, 2023![/b][/h3]

[b]Yes! In one month’s time, we are launching the full-release version of the game here on Steam![/b]

[h2][b]✨ Patch Notes + Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Hello There, Castaways! 🏝️[/b][/h1]

[b]Our last Early Access update is here, 30% off![/b]

At last, we are now ready with an extensive content update!
The game is pretty well finished. We have added quests and narrative, and even voice-over. We have adjusted and balanced the gameplay to give a better feel and make it more fun. We’ve made dramatic changes to the core game loop. We’ve even added Steam achievements!

[i]Fair warning: With all these changes, the old save games will be incompatible and obsolete. Please start a new game for an optimal experience.[/i]
 
This is likely the final content update before launch. From now on, we will focus on fixing any remaining bugs and a bit of polish here and there. 

Please see the list further down for detail about all the new content and features. 

We hope you enjoy what we've prepared for you over these last months ♥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]✨ New Features[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] We are so eager to share the full story with you! The main story has been improved and we have added voiceovers from our awesome voice actors. Each of the characters you find on the island now has their own side quest/storyline bringing out their wonderful personalities.
[list][*] All new main and side quests have been added to the game[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/93c8a4527601598b258a08cffa1d6346b84c2ef6.gif[/img]

[*] The Bloombox! 
We are giving you the freedom to choose your music! Well, you have to work for it. First, you need to craft a boombox, like an old gramophone. Then you need to explore the island and craft the discs you receive as rewards for building work orders. Each disk represents a different character, creature, or place. You can place the Bloombox wherever you like and play your favorite songs as you collect them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/6acae334bcbe78a645978f092b7fea9531b42ba7.gif[/img]

[*] Our new Day / Night system, the Cloud Cycle, traps players in an endless night until they sleep. As you might recall, mutated plants roam when the island is shrouded. So use this time to combat the mutated plants and gather their seeds to craft plants for your beautiful garden.
You can always go to sleep in your bed and skip the night, and as a new day begins we now display your progress in the Daily summary screen. Here you can see how many Ribbits you earned that day amongst many other things!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/b1b1c7318eb8f3ecc1ac3c2490d41bc0bd6f079e.gif[/img]

notes.title: A Major Update is Coming to Ikonei Island!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/6fdbf33cc1c220d5c8924866585a4e9ac014904e.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Dear Early Accessers and players of Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure,[/b][/h1]

Hey there! First and foremost, we owe you a big apology for the long pause in updates and for not keeping you in the loop about the development of Ikonei Island. Our bad! We're truly sorry for leaving you hanging for so long.

But rest assured, it hasn't been a time of slacking off. In fact, we've been working hard to bring you an incredible game experience. Since the last patch, we've made significant progress by adding all the narrative, balancing the game, and incorporating more content. We've also addressed numerous bugs and even expanded the game to support multiple languages (Spanish, French, German, Norwegian, Simplified Chinese). However, all these presented unexpected challenges and resulted in unforeseen bugs that took longer to fix than anticipated.

Soon, we'll be releasing an Early Access patch that brings these updates to you. Following that, we'll be dedicating our efforts to bug fixing until the full launch. Unfortunately, there are still some multiplayer bugs that need to be squashed, but we're committed to resolving them.

We can't thank you enough for your unwavering support and patience throughout this journey. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've taken it to heart in our quest to make Ikonei Island the game you deserve. Your dedication to the game has truly inspired us, and we're honored to have players like you as part of our community. 
Now, let's dive into a (very) shortened preview of what's coming in the next update! We've got some exciting features lined up that we know you'll love:

[list]
[*] New Day/Night system
[*] Engaging storylines and captivating cutscenes
[*] Introducing the Bloombox feature
[*] Automatic pickup of dropped resources by nearby players
[*] Added voice acting for an enhanced gaming experience
[/list]
We're eager to share more details about these updates soon, so keep an eye out for further announcements. Your feedback remains crucial to us, so please continue to share your thoughts and suggestions.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the radio silence and any inconvenience caused. We appreciate your understanding and unwavering support. Get ready to embark on an adventure like no other!

[b][i]The Ikonei Island Development Team[/i][/b]

[*] Improved visuals on Character outfits in the inventory view

[*] Added longer animations for disassembling player houses
[/list]

[list]
[*] All monsters now have a sight perception, and will attack players on sight
[*] It should be easier to avoid enemy attacks now
[*] Reduced knockback caused by Hammer and Hatchet
[*] More monster variations were added to the island, both weaker and stronger versions
[/list]
[h3][b]💎 Resource Gathering[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Amrified resource nodes added
[*] It should be easier to catch fish
[*] New Digging and Leaf Bush Node added 
[/list]
[h3][b]🧰 Tools[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Watering Can can now be bought in Sariel’s Shop
[/list]
[h3][b]🎶 Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimization of Music and Ambience Systems
[*] Improvements in the Weather sound system
[*] Improvements in the Audio Mix of the full game
[/list]

[*] Fixes to the Audio Menu Settings system
[*] Fixes to Creature Sounds
[*] Fixes to areas where the player could get stuck or go out of bounds
[*] Fixes to issues that could cause wrong character icons to appear on the map
[*] Fixes to NPC Sounds

[*] Players can now pick up items if the first row in the inventory is full

[h1][b]Hello There, Castaways! 🏝️[/b][/h1]

After tending to your crops, you decide to go for a walk on the beach with your critter friend. It runs past you, jumping, while you crouch to pick some frogs.

You hear your furry companion making noises, trying to alert you. But as you raise your head to check on it, you bump it into something and fall backwards.

What was that? As you stare forward, you see a wooden chest opening up. Your lil' pal stands by your side looking anxiously at it. On it, there's a plaque that reads:

[h3][b]Ikonei Island's First Major Update![/b][/h3]

You get up, approach the chest and stare inside. Here's what you see!

[h2][b]🐸 Huge Creature Pass[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/feaef9cff527d37432e311c95357c07fde3e2c02.gif[/img]
[i]A castaway is never alone! Explore the island with all of your critter frens ♥[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/5fabf69ee0c4024d26e6b5e08cd5901202f26238.gif[/img]
[i]Wanna take a closer look when interacting with your lil' pals? We got you![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/3e9da3c1e59895871d76cc8faee242c1e74b458e.gif[/img]
[i]Companions can now be commanded to perform their actions! Bonding is no longer required, but still possible.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/b5cb2c1fe068c6f5061173ec3d5558302c50034c.gif[/img]
[i]It's not pss pss pss, it's [insert name]! Give nicknames to your pals - which will be shown above their heads - and check how happy they are with the mood meter feature.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/3f941eded95ca6cda8a7b4f9fb02ac038a9d65b3.gif[/img]
[i]Creatures can now be fed, washed, and played with to increase their mood and experience bar![/i]
[hr][/hr]
And more:

[list]
[*] Improved locomotion animations for all companions (Stormdog, Otterlot, Longhorn, Axepecker, and Bibi);
[*] Improved creature summoning and dismissing;
[*] Improved Hogbunny dismiss animation;
[*] Extended animations for playing with the creatures;
[*] Improved idle animation for Stormdog.
[/list]
[h2][b]🏘️ Home Sweet Home[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/b94cb29a5f2eb35b93802a042057a3bce788ea88.gif[/img]
[i]Have you ever dreamed of living in a tree house? Now you can![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/4e4fe87deb6861523b3b5f7f621b1357f03db95f.gif[/img]
[i]You can also decorate a cave house however you like! We've prepared a lot of new placeables for you ♥![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/63c54f5588987f34f5457783cf093b96533d5794.gif[/img]
[i]You can even put all 3 houses in the same spot to make your own little hamlet if you wish![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]👩‍🌾 Easier Farming[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/86d4dc5e3d65aa2b559c5fdbde3b017759d2ddf8.gif[/img]
[i]You can use the crops on your farm to do all kinds of things, like restore health, feed your creatures or make some profit. To this end, we wanted to make sure that farming felt easy and fluid to do. 
Orientation of tilled ground should now feel even better, and it will be easy to design your farm however you want![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/614414028ab7b80c5bc28a3f296f9f517b3531d4.gif[/img]
[i]We also wanted to speed up the process for players a bit, so players will now be instantly gratified with new crops after pollinating the plants with the Queen Bibi, or the Pollen Bag.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
And more:
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Seed Pods[/b][/h3]
[list]

[*] Monsters now drop Seed Pods instead of Seeds, based on what region they’re in
[*] These Seed Pods can be used to craft the different seeds that the enemies no longer drop
[*] Petals refined in the Cutter now make Pollen Bags directly, no longer creating Pollen
[/list]
[*] [h3][b]Plant Definitions[/b][/h3]
[list]

[*] Uprooting a plant now gives the relevant Seed Pod back
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][b]🧰 Get Fishing & Digging[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/f738c2d78a00e3838b65bdae3480dd3a952e44a5.gif[/img]
[i]Although creatures remain the primary way to explore further into Ikonei Island, and collect raw materials, we felt that there were a couple of tools missing from the player kit.
Players will now have the ability to dig with their new shovel, and fish with their fishing rods. Get digging, and who knows what you might find![/i]

notes.title: The Snowcastle Team Has A Message For You!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/b6342450b27e36350a8368de0978745ba34793ed.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hello There, Castaways! 🏝️[/h1]

How have you been liking your adventures on Ikonei Island so far? Everyone here at Snowcastle has been absolutely stoked by your feedback, and has been busy doing our best to implement away!

Truly, not even 20 hearts can express how grateful we are for having you on our island ♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/eb4563c2d607010b208d88a04e3f9295b82d0f83.png[/img]
[i]A HUGE thank you from all of us![/i]
[hr][/hr]
In fact, you fuel us with so much motivation, that we can't stop jumping on your feedback like crazy frogs! Haha. You can be sure we are paying close attention to every single review, question, suggestion, report, and complaint. We promise to keep on making our wholesome adventure even better!

So let's take a quick look at what we've been crafting for you based on your feedback!

[h2]What Is Coming Up Based On Your Feedback 💙[/h2]
[list]
[*] Inventory freedom! You will have more inventory space and easier ways to deal with a full inventory;
[*] Lost in the beginning? We've got you! We will provide additional guidance in the tutorial sections of the game;
[*] No more donating the items at altars one at a time. Construction altar interactions will be more streamlined and simple!
[*] And [b]multiplayer coming sooner than you think[/b]! Stay tuned ;)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/18783c47816b1142d1d2da0589989bd8b06bb0b5.gif[/img]
[i]Check out the amazing creations some fellow castaways from our [b][url=https://discord.gg/snowcastlegames]Discord server[/url][/b] put together! Credits: Panda666 & Saké ♥[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Make Sure To Join Our Wholesome Community 💙[/h2]

How about having a dev answer directly to your feedback and questions?

Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/snowcastlegames]Discord server[/url][/b] and be that close to us! We would absolutely love to have you there to help us create the most exciting and beautiful experience for you.


See you on the island! 💙
